final: WITH color_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), total AS (SELECT SUM(item_count) AS total_count FROM color_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.color, c.item_count, CAST(c.item_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM color_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(item_count) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.item_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.item_count - m.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.item_count > m.value
